scope: Headless JavaScript render submission and exact primitive counts; not GPU time, browser FPS, CPU utilization or physics throughput.

method.renderer: Actual Q-bits custom WebGL1 renderScene in tests/game-harness.cjs
method.webgl: simulated; unique buffer IDs and distinct primitive enums
method.percentile: nearest rank p95; even-sized median is mean of two central samples

limitations: GL stubs do not compile shaders or execute GPU commands.
Timing includes JavaScript and assertion/mock-call overhead; it is environment-dependent and includes GC/JIT noise.
All-front cases expose culling overhead; no improvement is guaranteed when everything is visible.
Physics and production performance are outside this benchmark.
Bounds discard complete assemblies conservatively; a visible fragment can retain the entire assembly.
Actual browser A/B and player hardware measurements remain necessary.

sphereMath.scope: Only 2000 all-front intersectsSphere calls per sample; excludes game loops, bounds calculation, draw submission and GPU.
